name: omni-desktop-profile
description: The dsh profile the Automagik desktop app starts: dsh's own base and web app, its plugin market, Automagik's plugins (the Bot team and the welcome, from this repository) and Omni's (channels and canvases, from the Omni release omni.json pins), and the add-ons that connect AI subscriptions: dsh-subscriptions (the plans DSH doesn't sign in to itself) and Oh My Claude (Claude through the person's own Claude Code), each from a reviewed fork at a pinned commit.
